assembly_instructions: Open block-diagram layout — no enclosing chassis. A single thin backplane plate is the ground line and the structural root for every block. The classic 5-stage in-order pipeline runs left-to-right along +X: Fetch (x=-4), Decode (x=-2), Execute (x=0), Memory (x=+2), Writeback (x=+4). Between each pair of stages sits a thin tinted glass pipeline-register plate (x=-3,-1,+1,+3). Fetch carries the branch target buffer, branch history table, program counter and the copper PC+4 adder loop on its roof; Decode carries the integer register file and the hazard scoreboard; Execute carries the integer ALU and the integer multiply/divide unit; Memory carries the CSR (control/status) register file. A copper bypass/forwarding bus runs the length of the pipeline roof, returning results to Decode. The L1 instruction and data caches stand on the +Z side and both attach outward to the TileLink memory interface — modelled as its real channel pair, the A (request) channel and the D (response) channel — along the +Z back edge. The FPU FMA datapath (unpack -> multiply -> add/round, plus the FP register file) stands further along +Z; the MMU (I-TLB, D-TLB, page-table walker) plus the RoCC coprocessor port stand on the -Z side. Copper buses (thin cylinders) trace every off-pipeline connection. Scale is abstract-diagrammatic at 1x; backplane spans 12 m so bounds.radius ~7.5.

info.summary: Rocket is UC Berkeley's open-source 64-bit RISC-V application processor core: a 5-stage, single-issue, in-order pipeline implementing the RV64GC ISA. It is the reference in-order core of the RocketChip / Chipyard SoC generator.
info.description: Rocket is a 5-stage (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, Writeback) single-issue in-order scalar core written in Chisel. It implements RV64GC — the 64-bit base integer ISA plus the M (multiply/divide), A (atomic), F/D (single/double floating point) and C (compressed) extensions — and supports machine, supervisor and user privilege modes with full virtual memory. Front-end speculation uses a branch target buffer and a branch history table; the memory system is a Harvard-style pair of blocking L1 caches (instruction and data) backed by a TLB-and-page-table-walker MMU, and the caches attach outward over a TileLink interface whose master request (A) and slave response (D) channels are modelled separately. An IEEE-754 FPU runs as a decoupled pipelined FMA datapath, and the RoCC (Rocket Custom Coprocessor) interface lets accelerators be attached directly to the core's decode/commit path.
info.contractor: UC Berkeley (ASPIRE / ADEPT Lab), CHIPS Alliance

facts.label: Memory interface
facts.value: TileLink — A request + D response channels

parts.name: Diagram backplane
parts.role: Flat PCB-style thin floor plate that is the ground line and structural root for every block in the open diagram.

parts.name: Fetch stage (IF)
parts.role: First pipeline stage — fetches instructions from the I-cache and drives the program counter.

parts.name: Decode stage (ID)
parts.role: Decodes the instruction, expands compressed forms and reads operands from the integer register file.

parts.name: Execute stage (EX)
parts.role: Performs arithmetic, logic and address calculation; hosts the integer ALU and multiply/divide unit.

parts.name: Memory stage (MEM)
parts.role: Issues load/store accesses to the L1 data cache and the data TLB.

parts.name: Writeback stage (WB)
parts.role: Commits results back into the register file and retires the instruction.

parts.name: IF/ID pipeline register
parts.role: Thin latch plate carrying fetched instruction state from Fetch into Decode.

parts.name: ID/EX pipeline register
parts.role: Latch plate carrying decoded control and operand values from Decode into Execute.

parts.name: EX/MEM pipeline register
parts.role: Latch plate carrying ALU results and memory addresses from Execute into Memory.

parts.name: MEM/WB pipeline register
parts.role: Latch plate carrying load data and results from Memory into Writeback.

parts.name: Branch target buffer
parts.role: Caches predicted target addresses of taken branches to steer the front end speculatively.

parts.name: Branch history table
parts.role: Stores per-branch direction history to predict taken/not-taken outcomes.

parts.name: Program counter
parts.role: Holds and advances the 64-bit address of the next instruction to fetch.

parts.name: PC+4 increment adder loop
parts.role: Copper feedback loop adding 4 (or 2 for compressed) to the program counter each cycle, sequencing the fetch stream until a branch redirects it.

parts.name: Integer register file (x0-x31)
parts.role: 32-entry 64-bit integer register file read during Decode and written during Writeback.

parts.name: Hazard scoreboard / interlock unit
parts.role: Tracks in-flight register destinations and stalls Decode when a read-after-write hazard cannot be bypassed.

parts.name: Integer ALU
parts.role: Single-cycle arithmetic/logic unit handling adds, shifts, comparisons and branch resolution.

parts.name: Integer multiply/divide unit
parts.role: Implements the RV64M extension — iterative integer multiply and divide.

parts.name: Control/status register file (CSRs)
parts.role: Holds the machine/supervisor/user control and status registers — privilege state, trap vectors and the SATP page-table base.

parts.name: Operand bypass / forwarding bus
parts.role: Roof-level forwarding bus that returns ALU, multiply and load results from Execute, Memory and Writeback back to Decode so dependent instructions issue without stalling.

parts.name: L1 instruction cache
parts.role: 4-way set-associative 16 KiB L1 cache supplying instruction words to the Fetch stage.

parts.name: L1 data cache
parts.role: Blocking 16 KiB L1 data cache servicing loads and stores from the Memory stage.

parts.name: TileLink A (request) channel
parts.role: Master-to-slave TileLink channel carrying L1 instruction- and data-cache miss requests (address + opcode) outward to the L2/uncore interconnect.

parts.name: TileLink D (response) channel
parts.role: Slave-to-master TileLink channel returning refill data and grant/ack responses inward to the L1 caches, completing the coherent A/D handshake.

parts.name: FPU FMA stage 1 — unpack
parts.role: First FPU stage — unpacks IEEE-754 operands and aligns exponents for the fused multiply-add.

parts.name: FPU FMA stage 2 — multiply
parts.role: Middle FPU stage — computes the significand product of the fused multiply-add datapath.

parts.name: FPU FMA stage 3 — add/round
parts.role: Final FPU stage — adds the addend, normalizes and rounds the IEEE-754 result.

parts.name: Floating-point register file (f0-f31)
parts.role: 32-entry 64-bit floating-point register file feeding and retiring FPU operands.

parts.name: Instruction TLB
parts.role: 32-entry fully-associative instruction-side TLB translating fetch virtual addresses to physical.

parts.name: Data TLB
parts.role: 32-entry fully-associative data-side TLB translating load/store virtual addresses to physical.

parts.name: Page-table walker
parts.role: Hardware MMU engine that walks the in-memory page tables to refill the I-TLB and D-TLB on a miss.

parts.name: RoCC coprocessor interface port
parts.role: Rocket Custom Coprocessor port that hands custom instructions to and receives results from attached accelerators, tied to the Writeback spine by its commit-path bus.

parts.name: Copper bus — Fetch to I-cache
parts.role: Carries instruction-fetch requests and returned instruction words between Fetch and the L1 I-cache.

parts.name: Copper bus — Memory to D-cache
parts.role: Carries load/store traffic between the Memory stage and the L1 data cache.

parts.name: Copper bus — I-cache to TileLink A channel
parts.role: Routes L1 instruction-cache miss refill requests outward onto the TileLink A (request) channel.

parts.name: Copper bus — D-cache to TileLink A channel
parts.role: Routes L1 data-cache miss and writeback requests outward onto the TileLink A (request) channel.

parts.name: Copper bus — Fetch to I-TLB
parts.role: Carries fetch virtual addresses to the instruction TLB for translation.

parts.name: Copper bus — Memory to D-TLB
parts.role: Carries load/store virtual addresses to the data TLB for translation.

parts.name: Copper bus — I-TLB to page-table walker
parts.role: Routes instruction-TLB miss refills to and from the page-table walker.

parts.name: Copper bus — D-TLB to page-table walker
parts.role: Routes data-TLB miss refills to and from the page-table walker.

parts.name: Copper bus — Execute to FPU
parts.role: Decoupled bus dispatching floating-point operations from Execute into the FPU FMA datapath at its unpack stage.

parts.name: Copper bus — Writeback to RoCC port
parts.role: Commit-path bus connecting the Writeback stage to the RoCC coprocessor port for accelerator instruction dispatch and result return.
